extracted.name: Oreo Milkshake
extracted.description: A deliciously creamy Oreo milkshake made by blending milk, ice cream, and cookies together for a kid-pleasing chilled drink that’s ready in minutes.
instruction_lines: Blend chocolate sandwich cookies, ice cream, and milk together in a blender until smooth. Pour into 2 glasses.
